finding: Selected reference `specs/request-consistency.md#requirements` has no matching Input snapshot: no Input has filePath `specs/request-consistency.md`. The selected requirement cannot be checked against its content, so any obligation it defines is unverifiable from the complete request.

Selected reference `specs/image-cache.md#preview-cleanup` (cleanup of the documentation renderer's image preview cache after 24 hours) does not serve any delivery item. The What to build paragraph lists Validation Report, Result Summary, invalid-input diagnostic wording, indexed cache lookup, single-scan parser strategy, protected access review, promotion, recovery, runtime migration and Reader Index Update, and none of them is image preview cleanup. An unrelated section cannot be a governing requirement of this issue.

Whether the selected `specs/export-retention.md#conditional-export-retention` belongs to this delivery cannot be determined. The section applies only if the new reader target is a generated artifact. The request establishes only that `docs/reference/validation-report.md` already exists, not whether it is generated or hand-maintained. The reader-index requirement also does not state whether external retention governs the change, which rules/02 requires governing designs to state.

The conditional export rule names `docs/adr/0005-external-policy.md#decision` as its authoritative source, but ADR 0005 limits its scope to promotion artifacts: `本 ADR 是本次 promotion artifact retention 的 authoritative source.` No Input establishes an authority for retaining a generated reader export, so the export retention obligation has no applicable source if the target is generated.

The freshness boundary of the 30-day retention is not established. promotion-runtime says the tracked artifact is retained `自成功 tracked commit 起保留 30 天` and attributes this to ADR 0005, but ADR 0005 gives only the duration and does not say when the period starts. export-retention also gives a duration with no start point. The start point needed to apply the retention is unknown in the complete request.

The successful `promote(inputPath)` result is defined in two incompatible ways. runtime-migration requires it to be exactly `{status: "succeeded", artifactId, trackedStateId}`, while the selected Result Summary requirement requires the same result to include a string `summary`. Both references belong to this delivery, so a conforming caller-visible result cannot satisfy both.

runtime-migration fixes the expected filesystem failure as exactly `{recovered: false, failureCode, priorTrackedState, baselineStatus}` and says other failure semantics follow Promotion Runtime. Promotion Runtime defines the same failure as `{recovered: false, failureCode, operation, priorTrackedState, baselineStatus}`. The exact field set conflicts with the contract it defers to.

The access-control source for protected promotion is undefined. runtime-migration requires that `Protected promotion 只接受已完成 access control 的内部请求` and that promotion does not evaluate or select an authorization policy. promotion-runtime says it adds no security boundary. access-review defines an authorization decision only for artifact reads (`Operation 在 allowedOperations 中时读取 artifact`) and states that it does not modify tracked state. No selected requirement says which decision authorizes a protected write, or how the caller-boundary to review-boundary handoff from rules/01 applies to promotion.

The single-pass requirement does not define how the architecture's error ordering is kept. architecture/05 validates in the order UTF-8 encoding, JSON syntax, root object, root fields, requestId, checks, then array entries, and reports only the first invalid field. The selected text requires one forward cursor that collects tokens and fields, but it does not require whole-input UTF-8 validity and JSON syntax to be established before any schema check. A pass that checks each field as it is collected can report a schema error that precedes a later syntax or encoding error, which the required ordering forbids.

The verified principal has no defined input. The selected text says access review trusts `the verified principal` passed by the caller boundary and that the decision is made `for the verified principal`, but Facts are exactly `{resourceId, operation}` and no selected sentence defines how the principal reaches the review. The trust contract cannot be implemented or tested.

The read authorization constrains neither the resource nor the principal. The policy is the same for all verified principals and decides only by operation, while Facts include `resourceId` that no policy rule evaluates. The selected text therefore authorizes an operation regardless of its target resource, and the security decision about which principal may read which resource is unresolved.

The invalid policy, invalid facts and Artifact Reader failure results are defined only by reference to `采用本文档 Interfaces 的 Other Results 合同`, and the Interfaces section is not selected. Under the selection rule an unselected section cannot become an implementation requirement, so the selected scope does not define these failure values, their policy-before-facts precedence, or their no-write behavior.

The selected Complete Operation Contract requires invalid input to return `按 Interfaces 的 Invalid Input Diagnostic 返回`, but the Interfaces section is not selected. The selected text does not define the diagnostic's failureCode, path, message or validation order, so the invalid-input behavior cannot be implemented from the selected scope.

The selected Promotion Behavior requires expected filesystem failures and rollback failures to return `Interfaces 的 structured diagnostic`, but the Interfaces section is not selected. The selected scope does not define the failure field set, failure code mapping, or operation name for these results.

The ADR conclusion contradicts the ADR it cites. promotion-recovery's ADR Evaluation says the rollback recovery result is `ADR 0001 已有 rollback responsibility 的表现形式`, but ADR 0001 states that it does not define `本次新增的 recovery-result 字段和失败生命周期`. The selected Recovery Result requirement introduces new public fields and a rollback-failure lifecycle, so this decision needs its own ADR evaluation and cannot be attributed to ADR 0001.

The verification approach for the selected promotion-runtime behavior conflicts with ADR 0004, and no ADR conclusion reconciles it. ADR 0004 requires runtime behavior to be tested through the public lifecycle Interface. The selected requirements make Readiness confirm request binding before persistence and apply the 30-day retention, yet Testing Decisions say these are `不作为公开合同单独测试, 按 Acceptance criteria 通过源码审查核对`.

The Not required paragraph selects the wrong format. It says only that the change `does not add another runtime Module`, but the selected requirement changes the caller-visible result of `promote(inputPath)`, which is a Module Interface, by adding a required `summary` field. An Interface change requires the full Module Design format. The paragraph also assigns the summary to an unidentified `existing result owner`.

The Not required paragraph is generic and cannot be evaluated. `The parser optimization preserves the current architecture` does not state which Module responsibility, Interface, Seam, dependency direction, authoritative source or data flow stays unchanged. The selected requirement changes the non-test parser algorithm (a single forward cursor), so the exemption must name the unchanged aspects specifically.
